L0@P0: Special Executive Report
L1@P0: DATE: December 14, 2021
L2@P0: SER#: 8887
L3@P0: SUBJECT: CME Group Holiday Calendar – Juneteenth Holiday
L4@P0: Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc. (“CME”), The Board of Trade of the City of Chicago, Inc. (“CBOT”), New
L5@P0: York Mercantile Exchange, Inc. (“NYMEX”), and Commodity Exchange, Inc. (“COMEX”) (collectively, the
L6@P0: “Exchanges”) recently published the 2022 holiday calendar. Commencing in 2022, the Exchanges will
L7@P0: observe the Juneteenth holiday each year.
L8@P0: As a result, the last trading date for the following contract months of certain CME, CBOT and NYMEX futures
L9@P0: and options contracts will be impacted as noted in the tables below.

L37@P0: *CME Three-Month SOFR Futures
L38@P0: SIFMA has recognized Juneteenth and recommends full market close in observance of the Juneteenth National
L39@P0: Independence Day. As a result, on Wednesday, June 19, 2024, the market will be closed during a prior scheduled final
L40@P0: settlement day for CME Three-Month SOFR Futures contract (the “Contract”). Pursuant to CME Chapter 460 the
L41@P0: Contract allow for the Final Settlement Price to be published on a day other than the third Wednesday of the contract
L42@P0: delivery month. The Settlement Procedures require the Final Settlement Price to be calculated and published on the first
L43@P0-1: day that the FRBNY publishes the value for the last day of the expiring contracts Reference Quarter.As such, the March 2024 contract month of the Contract will expire on Tuesday, June 18, 2024 with Final Settlement
L44@P1: Price to be published on Thursday, June 20, 2024. The last term in the calculation of the Final Settlement will be the
L45@P1: SOFR value published by the FRBNY on Thursday, June 20, 2024 which will apply for one day, Tuesday, June 18, 2024.
L46@P1: Similarly, the reference period for the June 2024 contract month of the Contract will begin on Wednesday, June 19,
L47@P1: 2024. Whereby the first term in the Final Settlement calculation will also be the SOFR value published by the FRBNY on
L48@P1: Thursday, June 20, 2024 which will apply for one day, Wednesday, June 19, 2024.
